purpose: Qualify Win64 FLTK recursive source enumeration and archive creation for a Unicode filename under Wine.
finding: MinGW dirent exposed directory entry names through the ANSI code page while the GUI paths are UTF-8. Recursive source enumeration now uses FindFirstFileW and converts each returned UTF-16 name to UTF-8.
scope_limit: This qualifies recursive UTF-8 member creation and Linux full/mini reading under Wine. It does not qualify native Windows, metadata, cancellation, replacement failure, or Profile 1 GUI creation.
